lead.text: Ruritania’s parliament passed its 2027 budget by 212 votes to 180.
In Freedonia, floods forced 3,000 from homes along the Sylvan river.

sentences.text: Ruritania’s parliament passed the 2027 budget by 212 votes to 180 after a debate in Strelsau.
Headlines on the left put cuts to Strelsau hospital spending first.
Headlines on the right put tax cuts for small firms first.

far_left.text: The far left headline puts the budget cuts that hit Strelsau hospitals first.

left.text: The left headline puts the austerity budget and its cut to Strelsau hospital spending first.

centre.text: Centre headlines put the vote of 212 to 180 and the debate in Strelsau first.

right.text: The right headline puts the tax cuts for small firms first.

far_right.text: The far right headline puts the tax cuts for small firms first, as a win.

closing.text: Left of centre the headlines put the hospital cuts first, while right of centre they put the tax cuts for small firms first.

sentences.text: In Freedonia, 3,000 were evacuated as the Sylvan river burst its banks.
The Sylvan river flooded towns in Freedonia.

left.text: The left headline puts the 3,000 forced from homes along the Sylvan river first.

centre.text: The centre headline puts the 3,000 evacuated and the Sylvan river bursting its banks first.

right.text: The right headline puts the river first, flooding towns in Freedonia.

closing.text: Headlines on both sides put the Sylvan river floods and the 3,000 first, the same on each.

sentences.text: Syldavia and Borduria signed a border trade deal at a summit in Klow.
Their leaders meet at a Klow summit on border trade.
